name: Goblin
desc: Small, mean, and mostly teeth.

name: Goblin Archer
desc: Shoots from the back and giggles.

name: Goblin Shaman

attacks.name: Mend Kin
attacks.text: mutters and a goblin's wounds knit

desc: Wears a lot of feathers and bones.

name: Goblin Warlord

attacks.name: Brutal Overhead
attacks.text: raises the jagged blade high overhead

desc: Biggest goblin. Wants you to know it.

name: Grizzlefang, the Goblin King

attacks.name: Royal Tantrum
attacks.text: starts stomping and screaming, the throne room shakes

attacks.name: Call the Guard
attacks.text: blows a horn: more goblins pour in!

desc: A goblin with a crown and absolutely no chill.

name: Wolf
desc: They hunt in packs, and they're patient.

name: Dire Wolf
desc: A wolf the size of a pony.

name: Winter Wolf

attacks.name: Freezing Breath
attacks.text: draws in a breath that frosts the air

desc: Its howl freezes puddles.

name: Skeleton
desc: Rattles when it walks. Rattles more when it's angry.

name: Skeleton Archer
desc: Never blinks. Can't.

name: Skeleton Knight

attacks.name: Executioner's Arc
attacks.text: lifts its black blade in a slow salute

desc: Its armor outlived its owner by centuries.

name: Zombie
desc: Slow, hungry and very persistent.

name: Ghoul
desc: Its touch locks your muscles.

name: Wight
desc: A cold intelligence behind dead eyes.

name: Bandit
desc: Your money or your life. Preferably both.

name: Bandit Archer
desc: Hides behind a rock and takes potshots.

name: Cutthroat
desc: Smiles a lot. Never at you.

name: Bandit Captain

attacks.name: Rally the Crew
attacks.text: whistles sharply — another bandit joins the fight

desc: Gold earring, silver tongue, steel blade.

name: Cave Spider
desc: Fist-sized. Then dog-sized. Then you stop looking.

name: Giant Spider

attacks.name: Web Spray
attacks.text: sprays sticky webbing

desc: Eight legs, eight eyes, zero mercy.

name: Phase Spider
desc: Blinks in and out of reality to bite you.

name: Mother of Webs

attacks.name: Cocoon Storm
attacks.text: rears up and her spinnerets begin to quiver

attacks.name: Brood
attacks.text: taps the web: her children come

desc: She's been waiting a long, long time.

name: Giant Rat
desc: Too big. Way too big.

name: Swarm of Crows
desc: A thousand beaks and a single grudge.

name: Stirge
desc: A mosquito with ambitions.

name: Wild Boar
desc: Angry bacon.

name: Brown Bear
desc: You were warned about the honey.

name: Owlbear

attacks.name: Crushing Hug
attacks.text: spreads its arms wide with a terrible hoot

desc: Half owl, half bear, all bad news.

name: Kobold
desc: Loyal servant of dragons. Terrible at it.

name: Kobold Slinger
desc: Pebbles. So many pebbles.

name: Kobold Dragonshield

attacks.name: Heart of the Hoard
attacks.text: raises its shield and its kin rally

desc: Carries a scale from its dragon like a holy relic.

name: Cultist
desc: Chanting, hooded, and committed.

name: Cult Fanatic

attacks.name: Command: Grovel
attacks.text: barks a word of command

desc: Their eyes glow when they pray.

name: Doom Priest

attacks.name: Doom Chant
attacks.text: begins a droning chant, the shadows lengthen

attacks.name: Dark Blessing
attacks.text: anoints an ally in black oil

desc: Speaks for the Doom. Loudly.

name: Lizardfolk
desc: Pragmatic, hungry, and considering you as lunch.

name: Lizardfolk Shaman

attacks.name: Swamp Mend
attacks.text: smears healing mud on an ally

desc: Croaks prayers to the drowned god.

name: Green Slime
desc: Wobbly. Corrosive. Somehow smug.

name: Gelatinous Cube

attacks.name: Engulf
attacks.text: quivers and slides toward its target

desc: You can see last week's adventurer inside.

name: Harpy

attacks.name: Luring Song
attacks.text: sings a beautiful, terrible song

desc: Beautiful voice. Horrible everything else.

name: Gargoyle
desc: It was a statue a moment ago. Wasn't it?

name: Mimic
desc: That treasure chest has teeth.

name: Will-o'-Wisp
desc: Follow the pretty light. Don't.

name: Bugbear
desc: Hairy, sneaky and terrifyingly quiet for its size.

name: Hobgoblin Soldier
desc: Disciplined, drilled and very orderly about violence.

name: Ogre

attacks.name: Crushing Blow
attacks.text: raises its club high over its head

desc: Big, dim, and permanently hungry.

name: Hill Giant

attacks.name: Boulder Toss
attacks.text: hefts a boulder the size of a cottage

desc: Not clever. Doesn't need to be.

name: Frost Giant

attacks.name: Glacier Stomp
attacks.text: lifts one enormous foot as frost races across the ground

desc: Their breath fogs even in summer.

name: Troll
desc: Regenerates. Unless you use fire. USE FIRE.

name: Minotaur

attacks.name: Gore Charge
attacks.text: paws the ground and lowers its horns

desc: It knows every turn of this maze.

name: Basilisk

attacks.name: Petrifying Gaze
attacks.text: fixes its terrible gaze

desc: Don't look it in the eye. Seriously.

name: Ettercap

attacks.name: Web Line
attacks.text: flings a sticky web line

desc: Herds spiders like sheep.

name: Green Hag

attacks.name: Mimicry Curse
attacks.text: speaks in the voice of someone you've lost

desc: Grandmotherly smile. Rotten teeth.

name: Mother Murk, the Bog Witch

attacks.name: Cauldron Eruption
attacks.text: stirs her cauldron — it begins to bubble violently

attacks.name: Toad Hex
attacks.text: points a crooked finger: 'Ribbit.'

desc: The swamp is her cauldron, and you are the soup.

name: Specter
desc: A cold spot with a grudge.

name: Wraith

attacks.name: Dread Wail
attacks.text: draws in the light around it, preparing to wail

desc: Pure malice wrapped in shadow.

name: The Hollow King

attacks.name: Decree of Ending
attacks.text: rises from the throne and begins to speak your names

attacks.name: Rise, My Knights
attacks.text: lifts a hand and the dead stand up

desc: A crown with no head. A throne with no kingdom. Yet.

name: Vampire Spawn
desc: Hungry, elegant and in no hurry.

name: Vex-Morrow the Bone Tyrant

attacks.name: Soul Harvest
attacks.text: opens its phylactery: green fire swirls into its hands

attacks.name: Grasp of Bone
attacks.text: skeletal hands burst from the floor

attacks.name: Raise Dead
attacks.text: speaks a word and the dead obey

desc: It was a king once. It still keeps the crown, just in case.

name: Dragon Wyrmling

attacks.name: Fire Breath
attacks.text: smoke curls from its nostrils

desc: Small, fierce and already hoarding.

name: Young Red Dragon

attacks.name: Fire Breath
attacks.text: rears back, its chest glowing like a forge

desc: Arrogant, greedy and on fire.

name: Wyvern
desc: A dragon's dumb, angry cousin.

name: Ashmaw the Red Wyrm

attacks.name: Inferno Breath
attacks.text: inhales — the air itself is pulled toward its jaws

attacks.name: Wing Buffet
attacks.text: beats its vast wings

desc: Mountains have burned for less.

name: Fire Elemental
desc: A bonfire with opinions.

name: Stone Golem

attacks.name: Slow Pulse
attacks.text: its eyes pulse with a slow, heavy light

desc: Built to guard. Built well.

name: The Iron Colossus

attacks.name: Furnace Vent
attacks.text: its chest plates grind open, revealing a roaring furnace

desc: The old empire's last soldier. Still following orders.

name: Chimera

attacks.name: Dragon Head Flame
attacks.text: its dragon head swells with flame

desc: Lion, goat and dragon — and none of them like you.

name: Sand Wurm

attacks.name: Swallow Whole
attacks.text: sinks beneath the sand... the ground bulges under someone

desc: The dunes move. That's not the wind.

name: Sahuagin Raider
desc: Sea-devils with sharp teeth and sharper tridents.

name: Sea Hag

attacks.name: Horrific Visage
attacks.text: drops her glamour

desc: Smells of low tide and bad bargains.

name: Giant Scorpion
desc: The desert's least friendly hug.

name: Squire

attacks.name: Bandage!
attacks.text: rushes over with a slightly-used bandage

desc: An eager squire who follows lone heroes. Nobody asked.

name: Spirit Wolf
desc: A friendly spirit-wolf.
